```text
# #3230: Patch: sentence case and one word per action across the client's labels and page names
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What it does

The client's words drift in casing and in what one action is called.

- **Casing:** most labels are sentence case ("Play together", "Hide tutorial", "Cries and keywords"), but some are Title Case right beside them:
  - "Dungeon Run" (`dungeon/StartScreen.tsx:463`, `routes/play.tsx:650`) sits in the same list as "Play together" (`play.tsx:655`).
  - "Privacy Policy" (`auth/ConsentFields.tsx:159`) vs "Privacy policy" (`routes/privacy.tsx:40`).
  - "All Random" (`routes/account.tsx:352`).
  - "Most Toppled" and "Never Tried It" (`stats/showcase.ts`).
  - On `/practice`, "Field Guide 0/36" sits next to "Hide tutorial", and the lesson "Field Spells and Traps" next to "Cries and keywords". These are seen in a browser.
- **One action, several labels:**
  - staying: "Keep playing" / "Stay"
  - leaving: "Leave" / "Leave game" / "Leave fight" / "Leave without saving"
  - Back: "← Back", "← Play together", "← All decks", "Back to Play together", "Back to lessons", with and without the arrow
  - closing: "Close" / "Done" / "Got it" (#3221 settles the dialogs' close control; this issue settles the words where a text label remains)
  - "Create an account" (title) vs "Create account" (submit) (`routes/login.tsx:1014,1022`)
- **A page's name differs by where it is named.** The command menu and the footer say "Card almanac", "Stats", "Privacy" and "Terms", while the pages they open are headed "Almanac", "Statistics", "Privacy policy" and "Terms of service".

Change:
- Add a short glossary to `apps/web/README.md` (or a `docs/` page it links). It should say: sentence case for every label, heading and button; a card's or keyword's own name keeps its catalog spelling; one name per page, used in its heading, the command menu, the footer and `<title>`; and one verb per action (Back, Close, Cancel, Leave, Stay). Write the words for each Back down too, so the arrow is the BackLink icon's job (#3218) and never a character inside a translated string.
- Apply it to the strings above and any others a sweep of `t("…")` calls finds.
- The i18n catalog is keyed by the English string (`src/i18n/zh-CN.json`), so rename each key there with its translation kept. A translation whose English meaning changed is flagged for review, not machine-translated.
- Extend `src/wording.test.ts` (or add a test) so a new Title Case label fails, with an allowlist for proper names (card names, "JackiOh", "Jlore", set names).

### Acceptance

- The glossary exists and the README links it.
- Each string listed above follows it, and the command menu, footer and page heading name each page the same.
- No translated string starts or ends with an arrow character (← → ↑ ↓); a test holds it.
- A test fails on a Title Case button or heading label outside its allowlist.
- `src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` passes, so no key is left without its zh-CN entry. The web tests and every e2e spec that finds an element by its text pass, with selectors updated in the same PR.

### Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #3218, #3221, #3222, #3223
```
